title: Unified quota handshake failure causing inconsistent throttling across hosted/dedicated/private
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Multiple customers across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments reported sudden silent request rejections (HTTP 429-like behavior) without matching quota dashboard signals. Investigation shows a mismatch in quota handshake semantics between the ingress proxy and the central quota orchestrator during transient network partitions and orchestrator leader changes.
impact_summary: Intermittent customer requests were rejected by edge proxies even though tenant quota ledgers indicated available credit. Affected customers experienced degraded UX for short windows (30s-3min) and some escalated to enterprise support. No data exfiltration; functional outage only.
repro_steps: Simulate orchestrator leader stepdown while proxy cache refresh is in-flight: start load at 80% of tenant rate limit, trigger orchestrator leader rotation, observe proxy returning 429 despite ledger having credits.
Run e2e on Private deployment with high-latency control-plane (add 200ms delay) and bursty tenant traffic; inspect admission logs for mismatched epoch stamps.
Replay production trace where proxy admission timestamp != orchestrator epoch timestamp and watch transient policy fallback to conservative denial.

root_cause: During orchestrator leader rotation the grant reconciliation path erroneously deleted ephemeral grant entries before the proxy received an explicit revoke. Proxies interpret missing confirmation as an unsafe state and apply a conservative deny path. This was exacerbated by an optimization that deduplicates ACKs and could drop the only grant-ACK under specific timing windows.
mitigation: Short-term: lowered conservative deny timeout on edge proxies in affected regions and enabled an additional guard that accepts last-known-good grant for 2 seconds post-handshake. Long-term: fix reconciliation to never delete active grants until explicit revoke is seen and add idempotent ack semantics.
proposed_fix: 1) Adjust orchestrator to respond with explicit revoke messages and avoid deleting grants pre-ACK. 2) Change proxy to accept grant proofs based on immutable handshake nonce rather than ephemeral in-memory flags. 3) Add integration test that simulates leader rotation with high concurrency to ensure no lost-ack paths.
rollout_plan: Merge fix into staging branch with feature flag 'quorum-safe-grant' default OFF for 24h smoke tests.
Canary rollout to 5% of traffic in us-west-2 and the Dedicated fleet for 6 hours; monitor 429 rate and ledger divergence metrics.
If stable, ramp to 50% for 12 hours; then full rollout across Hosted and Dedicated. For Private customers, provide a patch bundle and migration guide.
Post-rollout: keep conservative-deny timeout reduced for one week then gradually return to default after confidence window.
tests: Unit: handshake nonce sequencing and idempotent ACK handling.
Integration: orchestrator leader rotation + proxy admission under burst load (30kRPS simulated for tenant slice).
E2E: smoke test script per region that asserts no ledger divergence for 10 minutes during induced leader stepdown.
Regression: run existing quota back-compat suite against proxies older than runtime-1.20 to validate migrationless behavior.
